name: Eleven
description: A girl with psychokinetic abilities who escaped from Hawkins Lab. She becomes the Party's most powerful ally against the Demogorgon.

name: Will Byers
description: A quiet, artistic boy who vanishes into the Upside Down on the night of November 6, 1983, triggering the events of Season 1.

name: Mike Wheeler
description: The de facto leader of the Party. He gives Eleven shelter and leads the search for Will.

name: Dustin Henderson
description: The Party's science expert. His curiosity and optimism help the group navigate impossible situations.

name: Lucas Sinclair
description: The group's pragmatic strategist. Initially skeptical of Eleven, he becomes a key ally in the fight against the Demogorgon.

name: Joyce Byers
description: Will's resilient mother. She refuses to believe Will is dead and communicates with him through Christmas lights.

name: Jim Hopper
description: Hawkins' Police Chief. A troubled man haunted by the death of his daughter, who ultimately uncovers the truth about Hawkins Lab.

name: The Demogorgon
description: A predatory creature from the Upside Down. It hunts by tracking blood and is drawn to the Gate at Hawkins Lab.

name: Max Mayfield
description: A tomboy newcomer to Hawkins who joins the Party. Skilled at skateboarding and arcade games, she becomes a key ally against the Mind Flayer.

name: Billy Hargrove
description: Max's volatile stepbrother and a lifeguard at Hawkins Pool. He becomes the Mind Flayer's primary host, terrorizing Hawkins under its control.

name: Bob Newby
description: Joyce's kind-hearted boyfriend and former Hawkins Middle AV club member. A RadioShack manager whose technical skills prove vital — and whose sacrifice saves the town.

name: Dr. Sam Owens
description: The replacement director at Hawkins Lab. Unlike Brenner, he genuinely cares about Eleven's wellbeing and helps Hopper forge her legal identity.

name: Kali Prasad
description: A Hawkins Lab subject with the power to create vivid illusions. She leads a gang in Chicago and helps Eleven understand the full scope of her abilities.

name: Robin Buckley
description: A sharp-witted ice cream scooper at Scoops Ahoy who becomes Steve's partner in investigating the Russian base beneath Starcourt Mall. Fluent in four languages.

name: Erica Sinclair
description: Lucas's fearless little sister who infiltrates the Russian base through the air vents. A natural leader with zero patience for nonsense.

name: Mayor Larry Kline
description: The corrupt mayor of Hawkins who is in the Russians' pocket. He helps cover up the secret base beneath Starcourt Mall.

name: Grigori
description: A formidable Russian agent operating in Hawkins. He hunts Hopper and Joyce as they investigate the secret base, and is ultimately killed in the Key explosion.

name: Alexei
description: A brilliant Russian physicist forced to build the Key — a machine that opens gates to the Upside Down. He defects and bonds with Murray over Woody Woodpecker.

name: Steve Harrington
description: A popular Hawkins High student who evolves from Nancy's boyfriend into the Party's fierce protector. His babysitting skills and nail bat make him an unlikely hero.

name: Nancy Wheeler
description: Mike's older sister and a determined investigative journalist. She uncovers the truth about Hawkins Lab and becomes a skilled fighter against the Upside Down.

name: Vecna
description: A being of immense psychic power, formerly Henry Creel — the first child experimented on by Dr. Brenner. He becomes the ruler of the Upside Down and the mastermind behind every horror that has plagued Hawkins.

name: Eddie Munson
description: The eccentric leader of the Hellfire Club, Hawkins High's D&D group. A metalhead outcast who becomes an unlikely hero when Vecna targets Hawkins.

name: Argyle
description: Jonathan's stoner best friend and pizza delivery driver. He becomes the unlikely getaway driver for the California crew on their cross-country road trip.

name: Jason Carver
description: The popular basketball captain at Hawkins High who leads a vigilante hunt for Eddie after his girlfriend Chrissy's death. His fanaticism mirrors the town's hysteria.

name: Dmitri Antonov
description: A Russian prison guard who helps Hopper survive the Kamchatka gulag. He risks everything to aid Hopper's escape, earning the codename "Enzo."

name: Jonathan Byers
description: Will's older brother — a quiet, introspective photographer who sees the world differently. He becomes Nancy's partner in investigating Hawkins Lab.

name: Dr. Kay
description: The ruthless leader of the military quarantine around Hawkins. She hunts Eleven relentlessly, viewing her as a national security threat rather than a person.

name: Derek Turnbow
description: Holly Wheeler's classmate who becomes a target of Vecna's manipulation. The group uses him as bait in a dangerous plan to lure out the Demogorgon.

name: Holly Wheeler
description: Mike and Nancy's younger sister, now older and drawn into the Upside Down conflict. Vecna kidnaps her, and she develops a psychic connection to Max inside Henry's realm.

name: Kali Prasad
description: Returns to help Eleven fight Vecna. Her illusion powers prove critical in the final battle — but she is killed confronting the Mind Flayer.
